input: Use guides to overnight summer camps in upstate South Carolina (Kidding Around Greenville, Greenville Journal, Upstate Parent) to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: American Dance Training Camps Smoky Mountains NC 2026 Waynesville official

candidates.name: YMCA of Greenville
candidates.note: Camp Greenville offers overnight camp, adventure trips and teen leadership programs for grades K–12.

candidates.name: Bob Jones University
candidates.note: EDUcamp offers subject-focused summer programs; overnight housing is available for grades 9–12.

candidates.name: Girl Scouts of South Carolina—Mountains to Midlands
candidates.note: Camp WaBak offers girls overnight summer sessions with outdoor activities and crafts.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Christian youth camp offering summer day and overnight programs.

candidates.name: American Dance Training Camps
candidates.note: Overnight dance camp for girls ages 8–17 at Western Carolina University, with recreational activities.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Nature-focused overnight camps for grades 1–9 and wilderness expeditions for grades 7–12; 2027 dates announced.
